answer: Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 142 identities means 142 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Because the umber pair is tracked in the zenith ledger, the orchard audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Full reward requires answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 31%. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
